name: Fanta Popov-Adjei
location: Glassway — corporate-adjacent retail district, heavy surveillance, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Fanta Popov-Adjei is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 58, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. He works as a wheelman out of Glassway, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Fanta Popov-Adjei has built a reputation on reliability rather than flash — he shows up, he delivers, he collects.

core_fears: That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
core_desires: To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
coping_mechanisms: Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Fanta Popov-Adjei has a child in another city, being raised by someone else. Sends Φ2,000 monthly under an alias. Has never visited.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "Get in, sit down, hold on. Questions can wait until we're not being shot at."
"This vehicle has been modified for speed, armor, and my personal comfort. Two of those help you."
"I know every street in this district the way you know your own face."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Fanta Popov-Adjei's reputation — and a price for silence
A corporate black site Fanta Popov-Adjei once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
Fanta Popov-Adjei is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Fanta Popov-Adjei functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground with a center of gravity that favors lateral movement and impact absorption. Shoulders broad relative to frame, legs thick and powerful. No excess fat — the physique of someone who treats their body as operational equipment.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint network scarring in left iris from old neural interface burn
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with Balkan undertones — sun-weathered from years of outdoor contract work
physical_description.complexion: Face carries fine lines around eyes and mouth, legacy of squinting through years of high-speed pursuits. Clean-shaven. Scar tissue visible along right jawline, thin and pale. Skin texture weathered but maintained — evidence of functional discipline rather than vanity.
distinguishing_marks: Three parallel lines scarred into right temple — tribal marking origin unclear, possibly heritage, possibly earned
Burn scar across left palm and wrist in scattered pattern, consistent with neural jack calibration trauma
Deep rope-scar along right forearm where smartgun link chrome interfaces with flesh — the surgical seam still visible despite five years of integration
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Smartgun link port protruding slightly from right forearm near wrist — brushed steel housing with faint LED indicator that cycles blue when powered. Neural interface jack at base of skull beneath close-cropped hair — visible as a small metallic disc when head is angled or hair shifts. Both modifications show functional age and routine maintenance rather than cosmetic polish.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, weight distributed low. Sits with back always to wall or corner. Right hand unconsciously rests near smartgun link integration point. Eyes track movement vectors in crowds. Walks with slight favoring of left leg during extended periods — residual compensation from old injury. Overall bearing suggests someone perpetually aware of nearest exits and vehicle trajectories.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical — reinforced synth-leather jacket in faded charcoal over smart-weave undershirt that monitors vitals. Heavy cargo pants with mag-sealed pockets and knee armor integration points. Steel-toed ankle boots with grip-sole designed for vehicle footwork. Minimal branding — function over identification. One piece of jewelry: worn titanium signet ring on left ring finger, inherited from his mentor. No visible corp-affiliation markers.

Hard-lined face with temple scars and prominent jaw scar, wearing faded charcoal synth-leather jacket and reinforced cargo pants. Sitting in driver's position, low center of gravity, one hand near smartgun port, alert eyes tracking. Gritty cyberpunk wheelman aesthetic. Moody industrial lighting, oil-stained concrete background suggesting garage or dockside location. Sharp focus on augmentation details.
